task_definition.task_description: Please check that my investment account is active, confirm the NASDAQ is open, get the current AAPL price, and then use that to buy 10 shares of AAPL. After that, scan my living room devices, identify the smart lock, also check the living room light’s status, then get the lock access ticket for the living room and use PIN 2026 to lock the door, and finally send me a high-priority app alert confirming both the stock order and the lock command succeeded.

user_input.query: For user_01, please first make sure my investment account is active, confirm that NASDAQ is open, check the current price of AAPL, and then buy quantity 10 of AAPL. After that, scan the devices in my living_room, identify the smart lock, and also check the status of device_id light_living. Then get the lock access ticket for the living_room and use pin_code 2026 to set the lock_state to lock. Finally, send me a high-priority app alert confirming that both the AAPL order and the living_room lock command were completed successfully.
